cincinnati-ballet-center-for-dance.mobil: Both entrances to the building (the interior and exterior doors of the vestibule) have the push buttons to allow for independent entrance/exit.
Our elevator provides access between floors.

All of the studios at the Center for Dance are accessible for guests using mobility devices. Both the Sheakley Premier Performance Studio and the Community Terrace and Performance Plaza can accommodate seating for all people using a mobility device.
cincinnati-ballet-center-for-dance.chron: All restrooms throughout the Center for Dance have accessible stalls for guests with specific needs. Both restroom and locker facilities on the first level of the Center for Dance have shower stalls that are accessible for guests using mobility devices.
cincinnati-ballet-center-for-dance.cogni: Cincinnati Ballet presents a sensory-friendly version of select ballets throughout the season.
cincinnati-ballet-center-for-dance.mobil: Classes are offered three times per week and are available on a drop-in basis so there's no advance commitment required.
The accessible entrance is the Craig and Anne Maier Artistic Entrance. Please use the call button for secure entry.
cincinnati-ballet-center-for-dance.senso: Entry and exit to the theater is not restricted. You may come and go as you please.
cincinnati-observatory.mobility.1: The eyepieces on our two main telescopes can be anywhere from 4 feet to over 14 feet above the floor, which typically requires climbing a stepped platform to reach.
cincinnati-observatory.mobility.2: There is an ADA compliant ramp to the side entrance which brings visitors into the main floor with access to the classroom, lobby, and restrooms.
The Telescope Dome Room is only accessible by 5 steps with handrails on both sides.
cincinnati-observatory.mobility.4: There is level parking directly adjacent to both buildings. While there are no marked parking places, with notice we can reserve places with cones or signage.
cincinnati-observatory.cognitive.1: If you need additional assistance please inform us when making reservations or before visiting. Depending on staffing and equipment available, staff and/or volunteers may be able offer individualized tours and use of a portable telescope for stargazing.
cincinnati-observatory.cognitive.2: We are currently open by appointment only.
cincinnati-observatory.sensory.1: Due to our limited budget we do not necessarily have on-hand staff with the skills to fully assist vision, hearing or physically/developmentally impaired visitors.
cincinnati-playhouse-in-the-park.sensory: Moe and Jack's Place - The Rouse Theatre and the Rosenthal Shelterhouse Theatre both have a hearing loop system which works with existing T-Coil or Telecoil enabled hearing aids or cochlear implants. In addition, hearing enhancement receivers providing volume enhancement to patrons with hearing impairment are available. Please see the house manager for more information.
Large print programs are available upon request from the ushers.
cincinnati-playhouse-in-the-park.cogniti: Our sensory-friendly/relaxed performance is designed for anyone who would benefit from a more sensory-aware and relaxed theatre experience. Although open to all, these performances are offered to accommodate individuals with sensory sensitivities, anxiety, dementia, autism spectrum disorders, learning differences or challenges, and others who need a more accommodating environment.
cincinnati-playhouse-in-the-park.sensory: Signed performances for those with hearing impairments are offered for designated performances. Please see dates below.

Audio-Described Performances The Playhouse was the first theatre in Ohio to offer regularly scheduled audio description for the visually impaired. Trained volunteers describe the visual elements of the production via a hearing enhancement system, allowing patrons to hear dialogue, music and other sound effects. The description is timed to avoid interfering with dialogue. Before the show and during intermission, show and actor information are shared. This service is free. cincinnati-playhouse-in-the-park.mobilit: A curbside drop-off area offers direct access to the street level Box Office, lobby and elevator to the second level.

Moe and Jack's Place features more legroom and better chairs, and accessible seating in every section! The elevator for the new building will take patrons up to the balcony or down to the front rows of the orchestra section.
cincinnati-playhouse-in-the-park.sensory: Patrons who are deaf, hard-of-hearing, deafblind or speech disabled: Dial 711 to connect to our Box Office at 513-421-3888 via Ohio Relay services.
cincinnati-music-hall.mobility.1: The ADA Accessibility entrance is located on the southeast side of the building on Elm Street. From here, you will enter the Western & Southern Lobby where you will find the Box Office and two South Elevators that provide easy access to every level of Music Hall, including the Ballroom. A North Concourse Elevator also serves all levels, including the Wilks Studio and Balcony Parlor.
cincinnati-music-hall.mobility.2: Access Ambassadors are available at the southeast entrance on Elm Street. These ambassadors will help you find your way and assist you to your seat. Wheelchairs are available upon request for guests needing assistance from the curb or lobby to their seats.
cincinnati-music-hall.sensory.1: Assistive Listening Devices designed to enhance the sound of performances for guests who are deaf or hard of hearing are available at Guest Services, located at the northeast corner of Music Hall's Lindner Grand Foyer. This new system uses Listen Technologies' next generation of personal listening devices, and its integrated neck loop/lanyard improves the listening experience for T-coil users.
cincinnati-music-hall.chronic.1: First Aid Services are available in the North Concourse on the Orchestra Level. For assistance, speak with Music Hall staff member.
cincinnati-music-hall.mobility.4: Special seating is available for guests unable to transfer out of their wheelchairs or with other special seating needs. When possible, contact the Box Office in advance.
cincinnati-music-hall.chronic.2: Single Unit Restrooms can be found at the following locations: 1241 Elm Street entrance, near the Box Office North side of the Orchestra level of Springer Auditorium South side of the Balcony level of Springer Auditorium West side of the Ballroom
